title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
source: 2 source Matrix using SDB (shnid=2192) and AUD (shnid=122155)

ai_review.summary: Matrix source with a noticeable echo, yet it captures a monster ’82 show highlighted by a smoking Scarlet > Fire and standout Let It Grow performances.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its high energy, tight playing and especially the seamless Scarlet > Fire transition that many fans rank among the best ever. While most listeners love the performance, the matrix mix suffers from echo and slight sync issues that detract a bit from an otherwise excellent recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high‑energy, standout songs) offsets the mixed technical feedback; overall rating reflects good show quality with fair but usable recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Echo and sync problems noted; mix sounds off to some listeners, though others find it listenable and a nice homage to the original matrix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with a high‑impact second half; the Scarlet > Fire segue and Let It Grow keep momentum, while the set closes strongly on Baby Blue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals and guitar (especially on Tiger) are described as spot‑on; no blown lyrics in the highlighted songs.
